title: Swoff Configuration
description: Configuration for the Swoff offline-first service worker system

framework.description: Detected framework. Used to set sensible defaults. Set automatically by `swoff init`. When a meta-framework is detected, navigation.mode and strategy defaults are auto-configured.

features.description: Feature toggles — enable/disable specific functionality. Only serviceWorker is required; all others are optional.

requestBatchWindowMs.description: Time window in ms to coalesce concurrent GET requests to the same URL before dispatching to the SW. 0 disables batching.

connectivity.description: Connectivity monitoring configuration (online/offline detection with heartbeat). Disabling this also disables storage estimation and reset utilities.

enabled.description: Enable connectivity monitoring, storage estimation, and reset functionality

heartbeatIntervalMs.description: Interval in ms between HEAD heartbeat requests to verify connectivity

preventDefaultInstall.description: Prevent browser's native install prompt. When false, browser prompt shows naturally while event is captured. When true, prompt is suppressed and dev must call promptInstall() manually.

autoActivate.description: Automatically activate newly registered service workers (skipWaiting).

concurrency.description: Number of assets to precache in parallel batches

delayMs.description: Delay in ms between individual asset requests within a batch. Spreads out network requests to avoid saturation.

default.description: Default caching strategy for all requests

patterns.description: Custom cache strategies for specific URL patterns. Each value can be a strategy name string, or an object with strategy-specific options. Reactive-only fields (staleTime, refetchInterval, refetchOnReconnect, refetchOnFocus) are only valid with strategy 'reactive'.

staleTime.description: Stale time in seconds for reactive strategy. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchInterval.description: Auto-refetch interval in seconds for reactive strategy. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchOnReconnect.description: Refetch when the browser comes back online. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchOnFocus.description: Refetch when the browser tab gains focus. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

timeout.description: Override the global timeout for this pattern in seconds.

staleTime.description: Global default stale time in seconds.

refetchInterval.description: Global default auto-refetch interval in seconds.

refetchOnReconnect.description: Global default — refetch reactive entries when the browser comes back online.

refetchOnFocus.description: Global default — refetch reactive entries when the tab gains focus.

maxRuntimeCacheAge.description: Maximum age in seconds for runtime cache entries. 0 disables eviction. Default 2592000 (30 days).

normalizeKey.description: Normalize cache keys by lowercasing and sorting query params. Reduces cache fragmentation.

ignoreQueryParams.description: Query parameter names to ignore when matching cache keys.

storageThreshold.description: Storage usage percentage threshold that triggers automatic cache eviction of stale entries. 0 disables threshold-based eviction.

mode.description: Navigation mode. 'spa': serve precached fallback (app shell). 'ssr': cache individual HTML pages. 'default': no special handling.

preload.description: Enable Navigation Preload API in the service worker.

fallback.description: Fallback HTML path for offline navigation requests.

precacheRoutes.description: Additional routes to fetch and cache during SW install (e.g. ['/', '/about']).

rules.description: Per-route navigation rules. Each rule defines a glob pattern with an optional per-route offline fallback.

fallback.description: Per-route offline fallback HTML path. Overrides the global fallback for matching routes.

batchSize.description: Max stale cache entries to refetch per batch

batchDelayMs.description: Delay in ms between batch cycles

retry.description: Retry configuration for background refetches (exponential backoff)

maxRetries.description: Max retries for background refetches before dropping

backoffMs.description: Base delay in ms for retry backoff (delay × 2^retryCount)

maxBackoffMs.description: Maximum delay cap for backoff in ms

jitterMs.description: Random jitter in ms added to each backoff delay

retry.description: Retry configuration for mutation replay (exponential backoff)

maxRetries.description: Max retries before dropping a mutation

backoffMs.description: Base delay in ms for retry backoff (delay × 2^retryCount)

maxBackoffMs.description: Maximum delay cap for backoff in ms

jitterMs.description: Random jitter in ms added to each backoff delay

backgroundSync.description: Enable Background Sync API (Chrome/Edge only). Requires mutationQueue to be enabled.

type.description: Auth adapter type — determines how Swoff communicates with your auth provider

routePaths.description: URL path prefixes that bypass SW caching. Requests matching any of these paths are returned immediately before any strategy resolution.

enabled.description: Enable tag-based cache invalidation system (fetch/core, cache/tags, cache/invalidate)

debounceMs.description: Debounce window (ms) for coalescing rapid invalidations.

skipPrefixes.description: URL path prefixes to skip during tag generation

patterns.description: Custom glob patterns for tag generation. Keys are URL patterns, values are tag template arrays.

cascading.description: Cascading tag dependencies. {"todos": ["categories"]} means invalidating 'todos' also invalidates 'categories'.

enabled.description: Enable GraphQL wrapper with body-hash caching

endpoints.description: GraphQL API endpoints. Supports multiple endpoints.

serverPush.description: Server push event configuration (SSE or WebSocket). The service worker connects to a push endpoint and invalidates cache tags.

enabled.description: Enable server push event connection for real-time cache invalidation

type.description: Transport type: 'sse' (Server-Sent Events via fetch stream) or 'websocket'

reconnectDelayMs.description: Delay in ms before reconnecting after connection loss

swOutput.description: Output directory for the generated service worker file (e.g. 'dist', 'public', 'static')

swoffPath.description: Output directory for generated swoff helper files (relative to project root)

swFilename.description: Service worker output filename (without .js extension, e.g. 'sw' produces sw.js)

swUrl.description: Override the service worker registration URL. Use when the SW is served from a non-standard path (e.g. behind a CDN or reverse proxy). Defaults to /<swFilename>.js

precacheDirs.description: Directories to scan for precache assets. Keys are filesystem paths from project root. When empty, no directory scanning occurs — only explicit fallback routes will be precached.

prefix.description: URL prefix to serve assets under

matchExtensions.description: Only include files with these extensions (e.g. [".html", ".json"]). Omit to include all files.

stripExtensions.description: Remove specific extensions from the cached URL key. Only extensions present in this list are stripped (e.g. [".html"] strips ".html" but keeps ".json"). Empty or omitted means no stripping.

stripSuffixes.description: Strip these path segments before the extension (e.g. ["index", "page"])

excludeDirs.description: Skip these directories during asset scanning (exact directory name match, e.g. ["node_modules", ".git"])

excludeFiles.description: Skip files matching these patterns during asset scanning (supports *.ext glob, e.g. ["*.map", "*.ts"])
